use_policy.rule: Every prediction is stored as a pending AI proposal; an engineer confirms, rejects or reclassifies it before sign-off.

dataset.licence: VT-DS-001: CC BY 4.0, attribution required; VT-DS-002: CC BY 4.0, attribution required — see DATASET_LICENCE_REGISTER

thresholds.policy: score_threshold = argmax F2 (recall-weighted), review_threshold = argmax F1; chosen on the validation split

weights_licence.pretrained_init: Apache-2.0 model code; COCO-pretrained YOLOX-Tiny initialisation (Apache-2.0), fine-tuned on VT-DS-001/002 (CC BY 4.0)
weights_licence.fine_tuning_data: VT-DS-001: CC BY 4.0, attribution required; VT-DS-002: CC BY 4.0, attribution required — see DATASET_LICENCE_REGISTER

pretrained.licence: Apache-2.0 model code; COCO-pretrained YOLOX-Tiny initialisation (Apache-2.0), fine-tuned on VT-DS-001/002 (CC BY 4.0)

readiness_reasons: MLG-04: no per-class targets were agreed with a domain reviewer before the test run
MLG-06: missed defects have not been reviewed by a qualified person
MLG-01: dataset licence/provenance questions are open
known_limitations: Three classes: crack, dent, corrosion. 'crack' follows the VT-DS-001 source labels, which also mark holes, tears and other skin ruptures: read it as 'crack or skin rupture'.
Corrosion was learned from one Boeing 747 (VT-DS-002 'Rust', drone frames); results on other aircraft, paint systems and corrosion types are unknown.
Class mappings are PROVISIONAL_ACCEPTED by product-owner decision (CMAP-001 v2), not verified by a qualified inspector.
Trained and evaluated on public datasets (VT-DS-001, VT-DS-002); the test split is held out by photo group, not by aircraft, so it is not an aircraft-independent evaluation.
Accuracy is limited (see the recorded held-out evaluation): the model misses many real defects and raises false alarms. A missing detection never means the surface is free of defects.

Background images (ImageNet samples and generated non-photos) teach the model to stay silent on unrelated content, and an aircraft-surface check (VT-GATE-0001) runs first; neither is a guarantee on unusual images.
Robustness augmentation (blur, noise, JPEG, greyscale, contrast) targets phone, drone and AI-generated pictures; it was not separately evaluated on AI-generated images.
Decision support only. Every detection is a pending AI proposal that an engineer must confirm, reject or reclassify. Confidence is model certainty, not severity or airworthiness risk.
